article.title: Contents of application.
article.content: Every application for permission to sue as an 2[indigent person] shall contain the particulars required in regard to plaints in suits: a schedule of any movable or immovable property belonging to the applicant, with the estimated value thereof, shall be annexed thereto; and it shall be signed and verified in the manner prescribed for the signing and verification of pleadings.
article.html:
2Contents of application.

Order 33, Rule 2

Every application for permission to sue as an 2[indigent person] shall contain the particulars required in regard to plaints in suits: a schedule of any movable or immovable property belonging to the applicant, with the estimated value thereof, shall be annexed thereto; and it shall be signed and verified in the manner prescribed for the signing and verification of pleadings.

2 Subs. by s. 81, ibid., for “pauper” (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
